Multi-stream residual with doubly stochastic mixing.

Nonlinear low-rank branches on linear layers.
Training LR scaling lives under pretraining.noble_* (active when use_noble).
x-nanoplm-group-notes.MoE \u2014 Mixture-of-Experts (pure_torc:
Requires: pretraining.use_packing: true  and  use_static_inp_size: true
Always-on: one shared expert; routing is always sigmoid.
x-nanoplm-group-notes.Recycling / Huginn architecture (pure_to:
recycling_loop_count: 1  →  recycling OFF (default).
Splits the L-layer stack into:
  prelude  P  — first P layers, run once
  recurrent   — layers P .. L-C-1, weight-tied and looped
  coda     C  — last C layers, run once
A learned 2h→h adapter consumes [s, e] at each recycling iteration.
Training-time knobs live under pretraining.recycling_* (when recycling_loop_count > 1).

global_batch_warmup_steps.description: Ramp global batch: 1/8 → 1/4 → 1/2 → full, reaching full at this step. 0 = disabled (no batch-size warmup).

stable_tokens.description: wsd only: tokens up to the pre-decay checkpoint (warmup included)

train_tokens.description: Total token budget for the single-phase schedules (lr_schedule: warmup_stable | cosine | linear), the only token budget those schedules accept. Mutually exclusive with max_steps: set exactly one of them, never both. Must NOT be combined with lr_schedule: wsd, which takes stable_tokens/decay_tokens instead. Shipped commented out by `nanoplm pretrain get-yaml` because that template defaults to wsd.

max_steps.description: Step-based override for train_tokens (lr_schedule: warmup_stable | cosine | linear): train for this many optimizer steps instead of for a token budget. Set exactly one of train_tokens or max_steps, never both; neither is valid with lr_schedule: wsd.

stable_steps.description: Step-based override for stable_tokens (lr_schedule: wsd only): number of optimizer steps up to the pre-decay checkpoint, warmup included. Set exactly one of stable_tokens or stable_steps, never both.

decay_steps.description: Step-based override for decay_tokens (lr_schedule: wsd only): number of additional anneal optimizer steps after the stable phase. Set exactly one of decay_tokens or decay_steps, never both.

muon_adjust_lr.description: Shared matrix-optimizer knobs (applied per-optimizer where supported): rms_norm | spectral_norm | none

max_wallclock_hours.description: Wall-clock budget for training, in hours. The run writes a checkpoint and stops at the first optimizer step past the deadline, even if the token budget is not spent, which is how wall-clock-matched ablations are run. The clock starts a couple of optimizer steps in so that torch.compile, autotuning and warmup are excluded, meaning total job time is longer than the budget; it also restarts on resume rather than accumulating across resumes. Unset (the default) runs the full token budget.

x-nanoplm-group-notes.Batch (token-budget surface):
micro_batch_seqs     = sequences per GPU per forward  (the VRAM knob)
global_batch_tokens  = tokens per optimizer step
Gradient accumulation is inferred from those two + manifest seq_len +
world_size. You never set grad_accum yourself.
x-nanoplm-group-notes.Duration + LR schedule:
Token budget, not epochs.
  lr_schedule: wsd
    set stable_tokens + decay_tokens
    stable_tokens INCLUDES warmup — it is the point where decay begins,
    not a length added after warmup. decay_tokens IS a length after that.
  lr_schedule: warmup_stable | cosine | linear
    comment out stable_tokens / decay_tokens; uncomment train_tokens
warmup_steps is used by ALL schedules.
Prefer tokens over steps. Step overrides (below) replace their *_tokens twin — never set both of a pair.
x-nanoplm-group-notes.Optimizer \u2014 shared & Adam side:
adam_* also drives the AdamW side (1D params + embeddings/unembed) when
optimizer is muon | normuon | nordion2.
x-nanoplm-group-notes.Precision:
Recommended: keep bf16 enabled (~1.5–3× speedup).
When bf16: true, hardware picks the best path:
  CUDA Ampere+ (A100, RTX 3090+)  →  bf16 + TF32
  CUDA Volta/Turing (V100, 2080)  →  fp16 fallback
  Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/…)      →  fp16 (hardware accelerated)
  CPU                             →  fp32 (no mixed precision)

mode.description: FOOTGUN: the stock default mode is "decay". Flipping only is_resume: true starts a decay run, not a continuation. Always set mode explicitly. Two resume modes: continue - finish the original token/step budget from the checkpoint with the original schedule. Takes NO decay_* fields. decay - anneal a stable-end trunk checkpoint over an additional budget. Set exactly one of decay_tokens / decay_steps. decay_shape is OPTIONAL (falls back to schedule default). lr_decay_to_fraction is REQUIRED for mode: decay. NOTE: decay restarts the dataloader from the start of a pass, so a resume-decay matches a single-run wsd decay bit-for-bit only when the trunk's stable->decay boundary is data-pass aligned; keep global_batch_tokens / world_size identical to the trunk's run. continue | decay

model_reject.reason: MoE per-layer state (last_expert_counts, last_aux_loss) is overwritten on every recurrent iteration; only the last iteration's routing decisions would reach the pipeline's expert-bias correction. Disable use_moe or recycling_loop_count > 1.
x0 captured once before the loop; per-physical-layer rescaling re-applied every recurrent iteration has unvalidated semantics.
Per-physical-layer residual scaling re-applied every iteration has unvalidated semantics; likely interacts with adapter + noise s_0.
mHC-lite multi-stream residual mixing has its own stability guarantees (doubly-stochastic mixing); interaction with the recycled residual stream is untested.

model_warn.message: RePO will re-predict per-head positions every recurrent iteration. This hasn't been ablated; consider setting repo_after_n_layers >= recycling_num_prelude_layers + (num_hidden_layers - recycling_num_prelude_layers - recycling_num_coda_layers) so RePO stays in the coda.
model_warn.condition: repo_after_n_layers falls inside the recurrent block region

pipeline_reject.reason: te_pipeline.py is out of scope for the v1 recycling implementation. Use pure_torch.
Recycling lands only in pure_pipeline.py for v1; the HF path is out of scope.

pipeline_caveat.message: fp8 + truncated BPTT gradient correctness is not validated. Disable unless you have a specific reason.
Recycled forward must compile the recurrent STEP, not unroll the loop. Enabling compile triggers an additional smoke test.
